text:
rachel: saw a small reconnect storm on /v1/stream in ap-northeast after yesterday's sticky-routing tweak. Console reconnect panel jumped but billing stayed flat. Thoughts?

priya: likely duplicate handshakes from proxy retrying auth. Our metrics tag by `socket_id` so we double-count. billing dedupes by resume_token.

tom: quick mitigation: mute the page and add an annotation to the panel pointing to rollout rl-2026-03-23-17.

priya: long term: emit `resume_token` and a `reconnect_key` (hash of token + 20s bucket) as metric tags and use that in dedupe dashboards. Behind feature flag.

ux: product asks we don't change global panels. Create an experimental "reconnect_dedup" panel and a tooltip explaining the behavior.

devops-bot: rollout: sticky-routing v3 rolled to ap-northeast at 10:12 UTC. rollout_id=rl-2026-03-23-17.

tom: snippet for key in Go: `key := fmt.Sprintf("%s|%d", resumeToken, ts/20); id := sha1(key)[:10]` then emit as tag.

priya: pipeline caveat: telemetry pipeline strips new high-card tags by default. I'll file PLAT-4099 to allow `reconnect_key` for 48h and update downstream indices.

rachel: owners: rachel->mute & annotation, priya->metric flag + infra ticket, tom->PR for banner, ux->experimental panel copy. We'll unmute after 1h if dedup ratio > 0.9.

priya: added temporary throttle on client retry path in SDK to reduce immediate bursts.

rachel: thanks all, monitoring the compare panel now :eyes:
